## DupFinder 1.2.1: deleting never bypasses the recycle bin

Finding duplicates works as in 1.2.0. This release closes a way a file could be lost.

- **No silent hard delete any more:** Windows deletes a file for good, without asking, when its recycle bin cannot take it: the file is bigger than the size limit of the bin (easy with videos), it is on a network drive or a USB stick, or the bin is switched off for that drive. DupFinder now checks this before every delete and keeps such a file where it is; the page tells you why, so you can decide yourself. After a delete it also checks that the file really arrived in the recycle bin.
- **FFmpeg download that keeps working:** the second download source for FFmpeg now points to a build that stays available for good (the last build of October 2026, FFmpeg 9.0.2). The build of 1.2.0 would have disappeared from its original source in a few days. An FFmpeg already in your `bin` folder stays in use.

Update: replace `DupFinder.exe` with the new one. Your decisions, the ignore list and the FFmpeg in `bin` next to it stay.
